Confirm joint stationarity only if both heads and numerical precision pass at both distinct actual laws. Save compact full/split risk second moments when replaying,not raw risk states. No changes to parameters,registration seeds,posterior/score thresholds or historical laws;no new labels,target/verifier calls or server work.
